source:
'Socrates,, having walked about, when he said that his legs were growing heavy, lay down on his back... he said that when the poison reached his heart, he would leave us.'

In Europe, since the Wars, there's no shortage of deaths, but this is among the gentler ones.
translation:
“苏格拉底走了一会儿，说双腿渐沉，便仰面躺下……他说，等毒药抵达心脏，他就会离开我们。”

诸战以来，欧洲从不缺死亡；但这算是其中较温和的一种。

source: Use Grail influence to reduce Dread. Cheerier than many Grail rites. That's Bancroft for you.
translation: 以杯之影响减轻恐惧。比多数杯之仪式都快活些——这才像班克罗夫特。

source: How many ways can I take notes? Judiciously; briefly; threateningly - no-one's paying attention. But I'm paying attention to them.
translation: 做笔记能有多少种派头？审慎；简洁；咄咄逼人——没人留意。可我一直留意着他们。

source: My old Légion uniform, meticulously mended by the elder Janvier.
translation: 我的旧军团制服，老让维耶缝补得一丝不苟。

source:
A pre-war passport in the name of M. Sylvain [[Huissier]]. My place of birth is given as Paris. That much is true, as far as I know, but it's not a name I often use. It can be convenient to travel as a Frenchman, but I can't legally be a citizen of both Britain and France.

So the passport is a forgery - and the Republic has issued new ones anyway, leaving it invalid. Everything's changed since the Wars.
translation:
西尔万·[[Huissier]]先生名下的一本战前护照。出生地写的是巴黎。据我所知，这一点是真的；但我不常用这个名字。以法国人身份旅行有时很方便，可我依法不能同时拥有英国与法国国籍。

所以护照是伪造的——而且共和国已签发新版护照，令它就此失效。诸战之后，一切都变了。
罗密欧—朱丽叶牌丘吉尔雪茄

source: Use a Knock Influence to subvert any two Influences into a Knock Memory.
translation: 使用一项启之影响，将任意两项影响转化为一份启之记忆。

source: Down to Traces [q=trace]. I've perked up a little. I'm no longer under active Surveillance, but still a subject of Rumour.
translation: 痕迹降到 [q=trace] 点。我稍稍松了口气。眼下已无人专门监视我，但关于我的风声还没散。

source: An echo, a resonance, an alignment. Influences are used with occult skills in crafting. They fade when travelling - except for Memories, which endure.
translation: 回声、共振、契合。制作时，影响可与秘学技艺配合使用。踏上旅途后，影响会逐渐消散——记忆除外；记忆留得住。

source: Aubière submitted to my blackmail - with surprising grace.
translation: 奥比耶接受了我的勒索——竟还颇有风度。

source:
I was the youngest chaplain in the regiment, but Father Schaller had taken me under his wing... 

Recall <link="mypaststoulioseve">My Past: St Oulio's Eve, Cambray, 1919</link>
translation:
我是团里最年轻的随军牧师，好在沙勒神父一直照应我……

回忆 <link="mypaststoulioseve">我的过往：圣乌利奥节前夕，康布雷，1919年</link>

source:
7-9 Traces: They're getting closer...

Current Traces: [q=trace]

[Starting at 7, there's a good chance Spencer will be arrested if he visits a station, government buildings, or anywhere else they might be watching for him. At Traces 10, this will become a certainty.]
translation:
7—9 点痕迹：他们越来越近……

当前痕迹：[q=trace]

[痕迹达到 7 点后，斯宾塞前往车站、政府建筑或其他可能有人监视他的地方时，很可能会被逮捕。痕迹达到 10 点后，他必定会被逮捕。]

notes: 专名或开发术语含义未明，按原文保留。

source: Spencer's spent more than a week in one place. This had better be part of a terribly clever plan.
translation: 斯宾塞已经在同一处待了一周有余。这最好是某项绝妙计划的一环。

source: But it might mean nothing at all...
translation: 但说不定，其实什么也没有……

source:
These were the years I drifted fleshless through the Bounds, thin as rain, empty as a soap-bubble...

Recall <link="mypastviaticum">My Past: Viaticum, the Bounds, 1942-1946 (?)</link>
translation:
那些年，我脱离肉身，在边境漂流；薄如雨丝，空如皂泡……

回忆 <link="mypastviaticum">我的过往：临终圣礼，边境，1942—1946年（？）</link>

source: No gentleman should need to look in a mirror, once they've gone out into the world.
translation: 绅士既已走进世间，便不该再需要镜子。

notes: Shibboleth 在此按“密语”处理。

translation: 记忆：圣艾格尼丝节前夕，1937年（？）

source: Only [q=trace] Traces - I'm no longer being actively Pursued, but I'm certain that I'm still under Surveillance.
translation: 只剩 [q=trace] 点痕迹——追捕已经停了，但我肯定仍受监视。

source:
The [[currency]] of the French State, named for the double-headed axe which serves the State as its symbol. 'WORK, FAMILY, HOMELAND.'

The francisque, like the franc, trades at about two hundred to the dollar.
translation:
法兰西邦国的[[currency]]，因邦国用作标志的双头斧而得名。“劳动、家庭、祖国。”

弗朗西斯克与法郎一样，对美元汇率约为二百比一。

source: Spencer's spent his fourth night in one place. Better move on.
translation: 斯宾塞已在同一地点度过第四夜。该上路了。

source:
7-9 Fascination: "TRUST UPWARDS. LISTEN TO THE LIGHT."

Current Fascination: [q=fascination]

[BE VERY CAREFUL. At 10 or more Fascination, the game may end.]
translation:
7—9 点入迷：“信赖上方。聆听光明。”

当前入迷：[q=fascination]

[务必万分小心。入迷达到 10 点或以上时，游戏可能结束。]
notes: 三条威胁提示（恐惧/痛苦/入迷）中唯此条作"务必小心"，与另两条"务必万分小心"不齐；统一。旧目录中的"迷狂"为过时术语，一并归位为术语表"入迷"。

translation: 我已拒绝帮助西农布尔。

source: You'll need an Ingredient for each open input slot - it has to possess all the [[Aspects]] below the slot. A flame icon means that the ingredient will be consumed as Fuel - if there's no flame, it's a Catalyst and you can reuse it.
translation: 每个开放的输入槽都需要一份材料——材料必须具备该槽位下方列出的全部[[Aspects]]。火焰图标表示材料会作为燃料消耗；没有火焰则表示它是催化剂，可以重复使用。
宁静的度假胜地，异象却在此留下伤痕

source: Committed to departure - the travel map is the only screen until confirmed arrival clears this. Engine-read; see the system coupling note.
translation: 已决定启程——到确认抵达并清除此状态为止，旅行地图会是唯一界面。引擎读取；参见系统耦合注释。

source: A list of names once used by the missing and dead, recovered to apply to the Dead of Kerisham.
translation: 一份失而复得的名单，列着失踪者与死者用过的名字。如今，这些名字可以赋予凯里沙姆的亡者。

source: Cigars, coffee, good soap. Rarities in the Europe of 1948.
translation: 雪茄、咖啡、好肥皂。在1948年的欧洲，样样都是稀罕物。

source: Only when you really need to dress up. Outside appropriate situations, only a few very old-fashioned characters will react favourably
translation: 只在你确实需要盛装时才穿。在不合适的场合，只有少数非常守旧的人会表示赞许

source: AK-COPY: Histories isn't open yet — try again later.
translation: AK-COPY: Histories 尚未开放——请稍后再试。
notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。

source: A stately, gleaming Citroën. The Bureau used this model, back before the War. A fine lambswool scarf lies crumpled on the passenger seat.
translation: 一辆气派而锃亮的雪铁龙。大战前，防剿局用的就是这个型号。副驾驶座上揉着一条上好的羔羊毛围巾。

source: To change your Outfit, find a Wardrobe area.
translation: 要更换套装，请找到衣柜区域。

source: AK-COPY: Link this game to your Histories
translation: AK-COPY: 将本游戏关联到你的 Histories
notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀；Histories 作为系列品牌名保留。
疑似开发测试词，按原文保留。

source: Elegance. The other face of poise.
If a pathfinding bug has got Spencer stuck, this will get him unstuck again. Don't use it unless he's properly stuck! It's not good for him!
translation: 如果寻路错误让斯宾塞卡住，这能让他重新脱困。除非他确实卡住，否则别用！这对他不好！

source: AK-COPY: Something went wrong — try again.
They've kept this cicatrix under control, but it doesn't look as if it's getting any better. Likely it discolours the wallpaper, inside. Residents often develop sympathetic marks of their own.
translation: 他们压住了这道瘢痕，可它丝毫不见好转。屋里的墙纸多半已经变了色。住久的人，身上也常长出与之呼应的印痕。
多塞特郡团上尉（已复员）

source: An early Renoir? The scent of flowers also hangs in the hall...
translation: 早期雷诺阿？大厅里还萦绕着花香……

notes: 保留原文方括号结构。
疑似开发测试术语，按原文保留。

source: An optimist would say: Europe's still healing. Others would say: Europe's taking its time to die.
translation: 乐观的人会说：欧洲仍在愈合。也有人说：欧洲只是死得从容。

notes: Nether-lands 含拆词意味，正文采用自然地名译法。
内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。
富文本标签与倍率按原文保留。
专名 La Malaise Raveline 暂译“拉韦林病厄”，待设定复核。

source: The game couldn't reach the internet - or our server is down.
translation: 游戏无法连接互联网——也可能是服务器停机。

source: It is imperative that Thunderpigs are given the attention they deserve. In fact, they should be given so much attention that they can't even snootle about in a trough without someone livestreaming it to PigTok.
translation: 雷霆猪理应得到充分关注，此事刻不容缓。关注还得多到什么地步？最好它们连在食槽里哼哼拱食，都有人直播到“猪音”。

source: The first time Spencer was dismissed from the Suppression Bureau, it was wretched. The second time was worse.
translation: 斯宾塞第一次被防剿局开除时，糟透了。第二次更糟。

notes: 内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: View a recipe anywhere; craft where venue and recipe match skill
translation: 配方可随时查看；场所、配方与技艺相符时方可制作

source: Drag this to one of your Active Items slots.
translation: 将它拖到任一活动物品槽位。
notes: Active Items 统一译“活动物品”；压缩 UI 句式。

source: A proud declaration of the State's struggle against immortality and corruption. Chez Feliz is the latest corrupt establishment to face the axe's edge.
translation: 邦国傲然宣示着对永生与腐败的斗争。费利克斯餐馆，便是最新一个倒在斧刃下的腐败场所。

notes: 内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: Sturdy, nutritious literature lairs gloweringly beneath a light topping of brightly coloured novels about people falling in things, falling off things, or inventing cocktail-mixing pianos.
translation: 结实、营养丰富的文学作品阴沉地潜伏在下方；上面薄薄铺着色彩鲜艳的小说，写的都是人们掉进什么、从什么上掉下来，或发明能调鸡尾酒的钢琴。

notes: 此处为配套说明“将影响保存为记忆”的加载提示标题，并非九艺中的 Preservation。

source: You are skilled enough for this recipe… but only with {0}
translation: 你具备制作此配方所需的技艺……但只能借助 {0}

notes: 疑似开发测试词，按原文保留。
疑似开发测试词，按原文保留。
开发占位文本，按原文保留。

source: Extremely dangerous quadruped, known for snortling, truffle- snouting and a billious dislike of cheese.
translation: 极危险的四足兽，以哼哼、拱松露，以及一提奶酪便暴跳如雷著称。

notes: 内部性相组合标识，按原文保留。
Schloss Nagelsburg 暂译“纳格尔斯堡宫”，待地名表复核。

source: Elegant ladies preen, elegant gentlemen cavort. More elegant ladies, some pulp Westerns, further elegant ladies, blood-drenched tales of Parisian crime, and one more particularly splendid lady with particularly splendid hair.
translation: 优雅的女士们顾影自怜，优雅的绅士们嬉戏作乐。更多优雅女士，几本通俗西部小说，又有更多优雅女士，鲜血淋漓的巴黎罪案故事，以及最后一位格外华美、头发也格外华美的女士。
PLACEHOLDER-AK: 销售收入以 {0} 支付
notes: PLACEHOLDER-AK 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。
内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: Recipe fits venue; but venue needs Skills {0}
translation: 配方与场所相符；但场所需要技艺 {0}

source: Using this item to help with a successful skill test will consume it! (A failed skill test won't consume it.)
translation: 用此物品协助技艺检定时，检定一旦成功，它便会被消耗！（检定失败则不会消耗。）

notes: 内部路线/状态标识，按原文保留。
内部菜单命令，按原文保留。
Zouche 作为专名音译，待设定复核。

source: A chilly stream of clear water competes against the rain. It's losing.
translation: 一股清冽的溪流同雨水较着劲。眼下败象已露。

source: The hands quiver desperately, as if trying to break free of this moment. Twelve division-marks watch hungrily. The Wars were hard on clocks.
translation: 指针绝望地颤抖，仿佛想挣脱此刻。十二道刻度如饥似渴地注视着。诸战让时钟吃尽了苦头。

source: As Yes, plus you don't mind us linking it to bug reports
translation: 除“是”的内容外，你也同意我们把这些数据关联到错误报告

notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。

source: Provides these Aspects in the Pool, to help you force successes.
translation: 为性相池提供下列性相，助你强行通过检定。

source: Xhe travels with a carnival named 'Rosa Mundi'. They were due to perform in Mimata, among the mountains and gorges of Lozere. I've informally discharged myself from the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, and I'm on my way there now.
translation: 她跟着一支名叫“罗莎·蒙迪”的巡回马戏团。他们原定在洛泽尔的群山峡谷间、米马塔演出。我没等获准，便自行离开了“今日”疗养院；现在正在去那里的路上。
notes: 原文开头疑有录入错误，依据同场景重复文本确认主语为 Nina。
Piggerazzi 糅合 pig 与 paparazzi，暂译“猪仔队”。

source: Acting in character is the best way to refresh your Aspect Pool.
translation: 以角色身份行事，是恢复性相池的最佳方式。

source:
Example introduction to a great new thing that we have introduced go us. Latest version includes:

- Stuff
- More stuff
- Bippity bip bip stuff alert
- New hats
translation:
介绍我们为自己推出的绝佳新事物的示例。最新版本包括：

- 东西
- 更多东西
- 哔哔啵啵东西警报
- 新帽子

source: Spencer's Passion provides Aspects, increasing the chance of success with Skills that use those Aspects. Final choice of Skills also determines a Sign which gives a small additional bonus. Current Skills which match this final Aspect Pool: {0}.
translation: 斯宾塞的激情会提供性相，让采用这些性相的技艺更易成功。最后选定的技艺还会决定一项印记，带来少量额外加成。与最终性相池相符的现有技艺：{0}。

notes: 内部路线/状态标识，按原文保留。

source: Usually brief description that sometimes goes to  multiple lines
translation: 通常很短的说明，有时会变成多行
右键点击阅读（仅限一次）。

source: “What kind of polyglot genius could ever hope to crack your impenetrable code?”
translation: “天底下哪位语言天才，才破得了你这无懈可击的密码？”

source: DATA POLICY: This will send your email address, game.log and most recent saved game (plus optional screenshot) to our secure database. If you chose LINK, it'll also include your install ID from your config file. We'll use your email address only to contact you about technical issues. We won't share it with third parties. We'll delete any bug report data on request.
translation: 数据政策：这会将你的电子邮件地址、game.log 和最近的存档（以及可选截图）发送到我们的安全数据库。如果你选择 LINK，还会包含配置文件中的安装 ID。我们只会使用你的电子邮件地址联系你处理技术问题，不会与第三方分享。你可以要求我们删除错误报告中的全部数据。

source: Spencer's Passion provides Aspects, increasing the chance of success with Skills that use those Aspects - currently, {0}.
translation: 斯宾塞的激情提供性相，提高使用这些性相的技艺成功率——目前为 {0}。
使用 {0} 份{1}之经历提升

source: This is a generous overpayment! {0}{1} for {0}{2}. Sure?
translation: 这份溢价很慷慨！用 {0}{1} 购买 {0}{2}。确定吗？

source: An Aaron Douglas woodcut of O'Neill's 'Emperor Jones'. I remember the play. The rebels killed Jones with a silver bullet; but he'd been a rebel too, in the beginning.
translation: 亚伦·道格拉斯为奥尼尔《琼斯皇》创作的木刻。我记得这出戏。叛军用银弹杀死了琼斯；但最初，他也曾是叛军。

source: This is the worst photograph never taken by a human being. It could be a boat. It could be a pig. It could be the inside of a pig. It could be the inside of a pig inside a boat. It could, in fact, be a photograph taken not by a human at all, but by a pig, perhaps from inside another pig.
translation: 这是人类从未拍过的最糟照片。可能是船。可能是猪。可能是猪肚子里。也可能是船里那头猪的肚子里。说到底，这照片没准根本不是人拍的，而是猪拍的——没准还是在另一头猪肚子里拍的。

source: Add an ingredient with Aspects {0} - the recipe will consume it
translation: 添加一份具备性相 {0} 的材料——配方会将其消耗

source:
An empty room - Nina's old room -
mine, now. I'm getting closer.
translation:
一间空房——妮娜原先的房间——
现在归我了。我越来越近。

source: Spencer could travel here from an adjacent station
translation: 斯宾塞可以从相邻车站前往这里

source: Add an ingredient with Aspects {0} - the recipe will not consume it
translation: 添加一份具备性相 {0} 的材料——配方不会将其消耗

notes: 开发测试词，按原文保留。
开发测试数值，按原文保留。
内部角色路径标识，按原文保留。

source: Your Signs and Passions feed the Aspect Pool. Spend pips to force success on matching Skill tests. Regain them by acting with Passions.
translation: 印记和激情会为性相池补充点数。花费点数，即可强行通过性相相符的技艺检定；依激情行事，便能恢复点数。

source: It rained blood outside Cagnes-sur-Mer, but we've mostly wiped the windows clean now.
translation: 滨海卡涅城外下过血雨，不过我们已经把窗户擦得差不多了。

notes: 内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: It was the worst of times; it was the worst of times. Remind myself of that.
translation: 那是最坏的时代；那是最坏的时代。我要提醒自己这一点。
notes: 保留 myself 的内心自语人称。

source: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet foo bar lipseum oftem nah. Hollywood bin get anoda interesting year: Deadpool face off wit Wolverine, Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni sue each oda, Inside Out 2 conquer di box office and Joker sequel no even come close.
translation: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet foo bar lipseum oftem nah. 好莱坞今年又有一出好戏：死侍对上金刚狼；布莱克·莱弗利与贾斯汀·巴尔多尼互相起诉；《头脑特工队2》征服票房，《小丑》续集却连边都沾不上。
notes: 首段为开发占位文本，按原文保留。

source: You are skilled enough for this recipe… but only with Hushery in a <sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace"> Quiet Place or <sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace"> Shadowed Place
translation: 你具备制作此配方所需的技艺……但只有在 <sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace"> 静谧之地或 <sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace"> 暗影之地施展静默术方可制作
notes: 保留所有 sprite 富文本标签。

source: Right on the border between... autumn and spring? It must be exhausting, to be a flower in this world now.
translation: 刚好处在……秋天与春天的边界？如今这世道，做一朵花一定很累。

source: Thank you to everyone who helped us get here! Whether you wishlisted the game or left a nice comment somewhere or told a friend about Travelling, thank you. Super thank you to everyone who's helping us test the game and sending us feedback, too.
translation: 感谢每一位陪我们走到这里的人！无论你把游戏加入了愿望单，在什么地方留过一句好话，还是向朋友推荐了《夜游漫记》，都谢谢你。也要特别特别感谢所有协助测试、发来反馈的朋友。

source: Increase Skills, or buy new ones, with Experiences that match Skill Aspects.
translation: 使用与技艺性相相符的经历提升技艺，或购买新技艺。

source: Neatly made, but patched with undisturbed lichen. It must have been weeks at least since anyone slept in these sheets.
translation: 床铺收拾得利落，原封未动的地衣却在上头打着补丁。这床单至少有好几个星期没人睡过。

source:
When I came back to Europe after the war, my heart told me I should seek out Nina Lagasse: actress, artist, witch. She'll know where I can find the things I need to fill my emptiness again.

	Nina is notoriously elusive, but I've followed her trail from Alexandria - where they brought me back - to Antibes - where I now arrive -
translation:
战后重返欧洲，我的心告诉我：去找妮娜·拉加斯。演员，艺术家，女巫。她会知道该去哪里，才能重新填满我体内的空缺。

	妮娜向来难觅踪影，但我循着她的行迹，从亚历山大——他们令我重返世间之处——一路追到昂蒂布——我此刻抵达之地——

notes: Libuše 为专名，暂按捷克语读音译写。

translation: AK-COPY: 请在约 1 小时内输入。
notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。
内部双字母代码，按原文保留。

source: This item is assigned as Active - it's modifying your Skill checks, and will be exhausted after use.
translation: 此物品已设为活动物品——它会影响你的技艺检定，并在使用后耗尽。
notes: Active Items 统一译“活动物品”；去除“正在修正”的机翻腔。

source: Bright water in the Riviera sun. There's plashery afoot.
translation: 蔚蓝海岸的阳光下，水色明亮。有人正在大兴泼溅之术。
notes: Plashery 为戏谑造词，译作“泼溅之术”以保留伪技艺名语感。
开发测试文本，按原文保留。

source: "There are common sentiments in every thunderclap. Let us acknowledge them." — A Thunderous Secret
translation: “每道雷声中都有共同的情感。让我们承认它们。”——《雷霆秘闻》

source: This will permanently delete this saved game, and cannot be undone!
translation: 这将永久删除此存档，且无法撤销！

notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。

source: 'Our company it was that shattered it,' Ghirbi says suddenly. He begins again to weep his molten tears... -- Conversations at the Stag Door
translation: “是我们这一伙把它打碎的。”吉尔比突然说道。他又开始流下熔融的泪…… ——《牡鹿之门前的谈话》

source: The Rue Racine is deserted. The rain? A curfew? Or some nastier reason?
translation: 拉辛街空无一人。因为下雨？宵禁？还是更糟的原因？

notes: 开发测试数值，按原文保留。

source: Extremely dangerous quadruped, known for snortling, truffle- snouting and a billious dislike of cheese. “I am fond of pigs. Dogs look up to us. Cats look down on us. Pigs treat us as equals.” — Winston Churchill
translation: 极危险的四足兽，以哼哼、拱松露，以及一提奶酪便暴跳如雷著称。 “我喜欢猪。狗仰视我们，猫俯视我们，猪同我们平起平坐。”——温斯顿·丘吉尔

notes: 专名/内部标识含义未明，按原文保留。

source: I saw Bronek in this carriage, and also in the rear carriage. 'Dappled,'  he said when I asked.
translation: 我在这节车厢见过布罗内克，在后面一节也见过。我问起来，他只说：“斑驳。”

source: Smoking in post-Wars Europe is common; but not everyone enjoys the smell of tobacco.
translation: 战后欧洲，吸烟很常见；但并非人人都喜欢烟草味。

notes: 开发测试词，按原文保留。
技术类型名，按原文保留。

source: Saw this in '37, the year before I went away. The Worms gave me what you might call an afternoon off, and I sat in the cinema, watching our heroes cross the border into Switzerland... that's when I started to plan my own escape.
translation: 1937年看过这部片，那是我离开前一年。蠕虫给了我一个堪称“下午放假”的空当，我便坐在电影院里，看着我们的英雄越过边境进入瑞士……我正是从那时开始筹划自己的逃脱。

notes: 内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: The circus train can't or won't travel here.
translation: 马戏团列车不能或不愿前往这里。

source:
Louis Bellon.
Sunset-red roofs
above grape-bowed vines.
translation:
路易·贝隆。
夕阳染红屋瓦
葡萄压低藤枝。

source: Westergren, the Lantern-long that at the Bureau we used to call the Diarist. As I recall, we were hunting Westergren back in the Twenties - but someone else got to him first.
translation: 韦斯特格伦，那位灯之长生者；在防剿局时，我们管他叫“日记家”。我记得我们在二十年代追捕过韦斯特格伦——但有人抢先找到了他。

notes: 呼应爱默生名句“A foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds”，保留标题式讥诮。

source: Entry requirements: at least one of...
translation: 进入要求：至少满足一项……

notes: 内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: AK-COPY: Get a code, then enter it on the website within ~1 hour.
translation: AK-COPY: 获取代码，然后在约 1 小时内到网站上输入。
notes: AK-COPY 为开发占位前缀，予以保留。

source: We won't collect any data about story choices
translation: 我们不会收集任何有关剧情选择的数据

source:
Antibes, Alpes-Maritimes. November 1948; at least as far as anyone can tell any more.

	Twelve years ago, in Cracow, the Worms hollowed me out. For the next three years they steered me all round Europe, until at last I got away to a place where there was a kind of help... the Worms are gone now, but I've only begun to fill up the spaces they left.

	I was back with the Bureau again when the Worms took me. But I still think of myself, above all, as...
translation:
昂蒂布，滨海阿尔卑斯省。1948年11月——至少，如今还有人能判断出年月的话。

	十二年前，在克拉科夫，蠕虫掏空了我。此后三年，它们驱使我辗转欧洲，直到我终于逃往某个勉强能得到帮助的地方……蠕虫已经离去，可它们留下的空处，我才刚刚开始填补。

	被蠕虫夺走时，我已经重返防剿局。但在心底，我首先仍是……

source: Unworldly Skills - the Nine Arts - can create single-use tools which unlock otherwise impossible conversation options.
translation: 异世技艺——九艺——可以制作一次性工具，解锁原本不可能出现的对话选项。
重大事件（悬停查看详情）

notes: 富文本占位标签，按原文保留。
内部 UI 键名，按原文保留。

source: DAMN IT ALL - a crash! Please help us fix this, with a bug report -
translation: 真见鬼——崩溃了！请提交错误报告，帮助我们修好它——

notes: 错误报告联系邮箱，按原文保留。
内部双字母代码，按原文保留。

source: Xs my heart's explained to me: I must find Nina Lagasse.
translation: 我的心已经说得明白：我必须找到妮娜·拉加斯。
notes: 原文开头疑有录入错误；按同场景目标文案顺译。

source: You've reached the maximum number of saves! (Congratulations?) Delete or overwrite an existing save.
translation: 存档数量已达上限！（恭喜？）请删除或覆盖现有存档。

notes: 时长参数，按原文保留。

source: The game looks best in 16:9 resolutions, but we'll letterbox for widescreen.
translation: 游戏在 16:9 分辨率下显示效果最佳；宽屏显示器会添加黑边。

source: In every history, Spencer was priest, conjurer, writer, investigator, physician, legionnaire... but you choose which one of those he felt most comfortable as.
translation: 无论在哪段历史里，斯宾塞都当过神父、术士、作家、调查员、医生、军团兵……至于哪一种身份最令他自在，由你决定。

source: Spencer's Passion provides Aspects, increasing the chance of success with Skills that use those Aspects.
translation: 斯宾塞的激情提供性相，提高使用这些性相的技艺成功率。
当前化名： 斯宾塞·霍布森先生

source: A NO PARKING sign directly between two parked cars. Darlan's grip is not irresistible.
translation: 两辆停着的车中间，正立着一块“禁止停车”。看来达尔朗也并非说一不二。

source: An unfamiliar model of Peugeot. Scrupulously clean, and empty as a showroom model.
translation: 一辆陌生型号的标致。干净得一丝不苟，空得像陈列室里的样车。

source: Spencer upset a lot of people before he went away. Some of them are still alive. Don't stay in one place too long.
translation: 斯宾塞离开前得罪过许多人。其中一些还活着。不要在同一个地方停留太久。

source:
Jacob Lawrence.
Choking on they went
to iron future radiant
translation:
雅各布·劳伦斯。
他们一路窒息而去
奔向铁铸的灿烂未来

notes: 内部角色路径标识，按原文保留。

source: Spencer is a hollow man. His Passions aren't deeply rooted yet. If your idea of him changes, you can sometimes evolve your Passions to different ones.
translation: 斯宾塞是个空心人，激情尚未扎根。若你对他的看法变了，有时也能让激情随之演化。

source: Spencer can travel here without crossing a border.
translation: 斯宾塞无需跨越国境即可前往这里。

notes: 内部双字母代码，按原文保留。

source: This will permanently overwrite this saved game, and cannot be undone!
translation: 这将永久覆盖此存档，且无法撤销！

notes: 品牌名按原文保留。

translation: 纯随机（可能连续出现相同结果）

source: The hands rotate lazily, like circling dragonflies. Since the Wars, clocks have grown unhelpful.
translation: 指针懒洋洋地旋转，像盘旋的蜻蜓。诸战以来，时钟越来越靠不住。

notes: 链接地址按原文保留。

source: Failing a Skill challenge gives you Troubles, but also additional Experiences.
translation: 技艺挑战失败会带来麻烦，也会给予额外经历。

notes: 时间格式串，按原文保留。

source: The rain's only half-erased the chalk. The bookshop owner must have re-lettered it just this morning. A determined soul.
translation: 雨水只冲掉了一半粉笔字。书店老板准是今早才重写的。真有毅力。

source: Europe is probably dying. But it's going out in style.
translation: 欧洲多半正在死去。不过，它退场时倒是很有派头。

source: I think sometimes that I will never look upon the sea without that memory surfacing like a shark - that memory of the knives of Ys.
translation: 我有时觉得，此生每逢望见大海，那段伊斯之刃的记忆都会像鲨鱼一样浮上来。
notes: Ys 按既有设定译为“伊斯”；调整语序以保留鲨鱼出水的意象。
